# intrinsicallysafephones.com

> Independent comparison of intrinsically safe and explosion-proof phones for hazardous areas (ATEX and IECEx Zone 1 and Zone 2, plus Class I Division 1 and 2). Facts come from certificates, declarations of conformity and makers' datasheets; anything not confirmed is marked as not verified.

## What this site covers
- A page for every certified phone, current or discontinued, with its Ex marking decoded, certificate conditions of use and specifications: https://intrinsicallysafephones.com/phones/
- Head-to-head comparisons of the main flagship phones: https://intrinsicallysafephones.com/compare/
- Rankings by zone, industry and use case, each stating its criteria, for example https://intrinsicallysafephones.com/best/zone-1-phones/ and https://intrinsicallysafephones.com/best/iphone/
- Brands: Atexxo, BARTEC, ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), i.safe MOBILE, Xciel and Xshielder. Dedicated intrinsically safe Android phones come from BARTEC, ecom and i.safe MOBILE; Atexxo, Xciel and Xshielder certify iPhones through Ex cases or conversions.
